learningObjectives: Count a simple five-step morning routine
Build confidence with age-appropriate self-care routines
factNotes: Morning routines differ across families and communities; present the five-step routine as one friendly example, not a universal rule.
Do not imply that all African children, homes, foods or mornings look the same.
Any local-language greeting added later must be reviewed by a fluent speaker before release.

musicDirection.theme: Bright original KORA KIDS morning theme with hand percussion, light marimba-like colour and warm acoustic textures.
musicDirection.rule: Use original melodies only; do not imitate or interpolate an existing children's song or soundtrack.

scenes.location: Tumi and Tala's Rainbow Town home street at sunrise
scenes.action: Sunlight reaches Rainbow Town. Tumi stretches, Tala taps a gentle wake-up rhythm, and Piko repeats their morning greeting.

dialogue.speaker: Tumi
dialogue.text: Good morning, Rainbow Town! I’m awake… almost!

dialogue.speaker: Tala
dialogue.text: Morning, Tumi! Stretch up high, then touch the sky.

dialogue.speaker: Piko
dialogue.text: Good morning! Good morning!

dialogue.speaker: Tumi
dialogue.text: Ready for our five little morning steps?

shots.action: Rainbow Town sunrise and home street; Tumi appears at window.
Tala enters with a soft clap rhythm.
Piko lands and repeats the greeting.
All three point to five colourful step icons.

culturalNotes: Keep homes and streets contemporary and varied; avoid treating one housing style as representative of Africa.

scenes.action: The friends practise steps one to four: stretch, brush, wash and get dressed, using counting and repetition.

dialogue.speaker: Tala
dialogue.text: Step one: stretch. One!

dialogue.speaker: Tumi
dialogue.text: Step two: brush. Two!

dialogue.speaker: Piko
dialogue.text: One! Two!

dialogue.speaker: Tala
dialogue.text: Step three: wash. Three!

dialogue.speaker: Tumi
dialogue.text: Step four: clothes. Four! We’re nearly there.

shots.action: Stretch sequence with large number one graphic.
Age-appropriate tooth-brushing guide beat; no product branding.
Wash face and hands; Piko repeats numbers.
Tumi briefly puts a shirt on backwards, laughs, then fixes it.

scenes.location: Rainbow Town kitchen and breakfast table
scenes.action: Step five is breakfast. The children count five colourful fruit pieces and practise taking turns.

dialogue.speaker: Tumi
dialogue.text: Step five: breakfast. Five!

dialogue.speaker: Tala
dialogue.text: Let’s count the fruit together: one, two, three, four, five.

dialogue.speaker: Piko
dialogue.text: Five! Five!

dialogue.speaker: Tumi
dialogue.text: You choose one first, Tala. Then I’ll choose one.

dialogue.speaker: Tala
dialogue.text: Thank you. Taking turns makes the table happy.

shots.action: Five generic fruit pieces appear one at a time.
Count each fruit with a simple number card.
Tumi offers Tala first choice; Tala thanks him.
They finish breakfast and place the five step icons in order.

culturalNotes: Breakfast remains generic and optional; do not imply one meal represents children across Africa.

scenes.location: Rainbow Town street and Busi Bus stop
scenes.action: The friends walk to Busi Bus, recap the five steps with movement, and greet neighbours politely.

dialogue.speaker: Tala
dialogue.text: Can we remember all five steps without looking?

dialogue.speaker: Tumi
dialogue.text: One, stretch. Two, brush. Three, wash. Four, clothes. Five, breakfast!

dialogue.speaker: Piko
dialogue.text: One, two, three, four, five!

dialogue.speaker: Tala
dialogue.text: Good morning, neighbours!

dialogue.speaker: Tumi
dialogue.text: Every family can have a different morning routine. This is our Rainbow Town way today.

dialogue.speaker: Busi Bus
dialogue.text: Beep-beep!
dialogue.performance: soft musical bus horn; no human speech required

shots.action: Walk-and-count recap with five large icons.
Friendly morning waves to varied neighbours without focusing on any single cultural stereotype.
Tumi gives the routine-differences line directly to camera.
Busi Bus arrives slowly, smiles and gives a gentle musical beep.

culturalNotes: Neighbour visuals should show everyday diversity without tokenising clothing, skin tone, language or disability.

scenes.location: Busi Bus stop in warm morning light
scenes.action: They sing a short original recap, invite children to count the steps, and say goodbye.

dialogue.speaker: Tala
dialogue.text: Five little steps and we’re ready to go!

dialogue.speaker: Tumi
dialogue.text: One, two, three, four, five. You did it with us!

dialogue.speaker: Piko
dialogue.text: Hooray! Hooray!

dialogue.speaker: Tala
dialogue.text: Good morning, Rainbow Town!

dialogue.speaker: Tumi
dialogue.text: See you next time for another adventure.

dialogue.speaker: Busi Bus
dialogue.text: Beep-beep!

shots.action: Warm morning group shot beside Busi Bus.
Tumi counts five on fingers; Tala mirrors him.
Piko chirps hooray and bounces.
Everyone waves; Busi Bus gives a soft beep; end card.
